dialogues.speaker: Aoi no Okina's Likeness
dialogues.text: (This is Aoi no Okina's likeness, as done by Albedo.)

dialogues.speaker: Aoi no Okina's Likeness
dialogues.text: (Xingqiu was the model for this portrait, and it depicts Aoi no Okina stealing away the poems that he himself had written, complete with some special touches from Xingqiu's own Liyue-styled clothes.)

dialogues.speaker: Aoi no Okina's Likeness
dialogues.text: (The source material does state that Aoi no Okina was a much older person, but... Oh well, Miko probably won't mind!)
